# Z3 Parser：输出本对比工具期望的 JSON，可单独编译
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(z3_parser CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)

# 自动检测 Z3：预编译包（需有 lib/libz3.*）、源码 build、或 find_library（系统/Conda）
set(Z3_FOUND FALSE)
file(GLOB Z3_PREBUILT "z3-*-x64-*")
file(GLOB Z3_SRC "z3-z3-*")
if(Z3_PREBUILT)
    list(GET Z3_PREBUILT 0 Z3_DIR)
    if(EXISTS "${Z3_DIR}/lib/libz3.so" OR EXISTS "${Z3_DIR}/lib/libz3.a")
        set(Z3_INCLUDE "${Z3_DIR}/include")
        set(Z3_LIB "${Z3_DIR}/lib")
        set(Z3_FOUND TRUE)
        message(STATUS "Z3: 使用预编译包 ${Z3_DIR}")
    endif()
endif()
if(NOT Z3_FOUND AND Z3_SRC)
    list(GET Z3_SRC 0 Z3_DIR)
    if(EXISTS "${Z3_DIR}/build/libz3.so" OR EXISTS "${Z3_DIR}/build/libz3.a")
        set(Z3_INCLUDE "${Z3_DIR}/src/api/c++;${Z3_DIR}/src/api")
        set(Z3_LIB "${Z3_DIR}/build")
        set(Z3_FOUND TRUE)
        message(STATUS "Z3: 使用源码构建 ${Z3_DIR}/build")
    endif()
endif()
if(NOT Z3_FOUND)
  # Conda 环境常见路径
  if(DEFINED ENV{CONDA_PREFIX})
    set(SEARCH_LIB "$ENV{CONDA_PREFIX}/lib")
    if(EXISTS "${SEARCH_LIB}/libz3.so" OR EXISTS "${SEARCH_LIB}/libz3.a")
      set(Z3_LIB "${SEARCH_LIB}")
      set(Z3_INCLUDE "$ENV{CONDA_PREFIX}/include")
      set(Z3_FOUND TRUE)
      message(STATUS "Z3: 使用 Conda 环境 $ENV{CONDA_PREFIX}")
    endif()
  endif()
endif()
if(NOT Z3_FOUND)
  find_library(Z3_LIB_PATH NAMES z3)
  if(Z3_LIB_PATH)
    get_filename_component(Z3_LIB "${Z3_LIB_PATH}" DIRECTORY)
    get_filename_component(Z3_PREFIX "${Z3_LIB}" DIRECTORY)
    set(Z3_INCLUDE "${Z3_PREFIX}/include")
    set(Z3_FOUND TRUE)
    message(STATUS "Z3: 使用 find_library ${Z3_LIB_PATH}")
  endif()
endif()
if(NOT Z3_FOUND)
  set(Z3_INCLUDE "/usr/include")
  set(Z3_LIB "/usr/lib")
  message(STATUS "Z3: 使用默认 /usr，若链接失败请安装 libz3-dev 或放置预编译包到本目录")
endif()

add_executable(z3_parser z3_parser.cpp)
target_include_directories(z3_parser PRIVATE ${Z3_INCLUDE})
target_link_directories(z3_parser PRIVATE ${Z3_LIB})
target_link_libraries(z3_parser PRIVATE z3)
target_compile_options(z3_parser PRIVATE -O2 -Wall)

add_executable(z3_parse_vs_solve z3_parse_vs_solve.cpp)
target_include_directories(z3_parse_vs_solve PRIVATE ${Z3_INCLUDE})
target_link_directories(z3_parse_vs_solve PRIVATE ${Z3_LIB})
target_link_libraries(z3_parse_vs_solve PRIVATE z3)
target_compile_options(z3_parse_vs_solve PRIVATE -O2 -Wall)

install(TARGETS z3_parser z3_parse_vs_solve RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
